title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1971-04-08

ai_review.summary: Good to excellent show highlighted by a beautiful Dark Star; recording quality is unconfirmed but appears acceptable.
ai_review.review: Listeners consistently praise the performance, especially the Dark Star and the inclusion of Sing Me Back Home, describing the show as enjoyable and memorable. No reviewer mentions any audio flaws, suggesting the tape sounds fine even though its source (soundboard vs. audience) isn’t identified.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating of 4.4 across five reviews, with strong positive comments about the music and no complaints about sound; limited technical detail lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on clarity, mix, or drop‑outs, implying the recording is listenable with no major issues.
